assumptions: The fragments already carry the method's tails: this predicts the reaction, it does not design the primers.
LIC's chew-back is T4 with dATP alone and USER's is a single dU per tail, as those methods define them.
limits: Predicts the products, not their yield, and models no mispriming or secondary structure.
USER needs a molecule whose uracils are in the primer tails: a uracil in the middle leaves a nicked molecule, which is refused by name rather than assembled.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does this set of fragments give under LIC, SLIC, In-Fusion, CPEC or USER, and is the homology arm one the method's own authority stands behind?

description: Join fragments without a ligase by one of the five named methods — LIC, SLIC, In-Fusion, CPEC or USER (pydna). Each method's chemistry decides which end survives, and its own authority states the arm it needs.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

arm_nt.description: homology per junction. Left unset, the method's own recommended arm is used (In-Fusion widens its own for more than one insert). In nt.

fragments.description: the fragments to join — wire upstream `record` outputs here, or name library documents.

include_subject.description: also include the node's subject as a fragment.

method.description: the cloning method, which decides the chemistry: LIC and SLIC and In-Fusion chew 3' ends, CPEC removes nothing, USER excises a uracil. Values: lic (LIC), slic (SLIC), in-fusion (In-Fusion), cpec (CPEC), user (USER).

name: ligation_independent_clone

arm.description: the homology arm the run used

armVerdict.description: whether that arm is one the method's authority stands behind, in its own words

record.description: the first product, as a record

summary.description: what the reaction gave, naming the method and its chemistry
